claims.claim: Codex builds AGENTS.md guidance from CODEX_HOME and project directories at run/session start, with nearer project files later in the instruction chain.
codex exec --json writes a JSON Lines event stream containing turn and item events.
Current local Codex releases can start a subagent after a direct request naming that workflow.
Applicable project or skill instructions can trigger a subagent workflow without a direct role name in the user prompt.
codex exec defaults to read-only and supports explicit sandbox selection; automation should use the least permissions needed.
Custom agent definitions can specify model, reasoning effort, and sandbox controls.
claims.section: Custom agents; Approvals and sandbox controls
